ledger.claim: POL-NS-04 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the chat log. Inside the waiting window that ran from the driver's arrival marker at 13:17:57 to the driver's cancellation at 13:24:38 the rider sent three messages: MSG-03204-001 at 13:18:27 ('im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you'), MSG-03204-002 at 13:20:27 ('hello? are you here') and MSG-03204-003 at 13:19:47. The first alone does both things limb (a) names - it requests the driver's position and states that the rider cannot see the vehicle - so the limb is met independently of the other two messages.

POL-NS-04 limb (b) is satisfied: the driver never answered. The chat log carries three messages and every one of them is from the RIDER; there is no DRIVER message anywhere in the log, so no reply was posted within 120 seconds of MSG-03204-001 (13:18:27), of MSG-03204-003 (13:19:47) or of MSG-03204-002 (13:20:27). trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so the driver placed no in-app voice call at any point before terminating the trip. A read receipt is not a reply: MSG-03204-003 shows read_at 13:20:07 and the driver still wrote nothing and called no one before cancelling at 13:24:38.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is satisfied on admissible fixes. The rider's own track places her device 15.07 m to 22.11 m from the pickup pin (mean 18.61 m) across 68 fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00, which covers the whole waiting window; all 68 are within the STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m of 100 m that POL-NS-04 limb (c) reads from the fee schedule, and indeed within the 50 m arrival radius itself. The rider was at the pin, not elsewhere, for the majority - here, all - of the qualifying fixes.

The wording of MSG-03204-003 ('im at the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side') cannot defeat limb (a) or place the rider away from the pickup. Limb (a) turns on the content of the message being locating or coordinating - an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the rider cannot see the vehicle - not on the named sub-location being the right one; and on the rider's own trace, all 68 of her fixes sit 15.07 m to 22.11 m from the pickup pin, so the message text cannot establish that she was anywhere but the pickup. Nor may any party assert that a named place is or is not the same venue, block or entrance on general geographic knowledge: POL-NS-03 confines that assertion to a venue_id or to a party statement in the chat log, and no party statement here places the rider off the pin.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. The driver's payout is displaced as well as the fee: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and POL-NS-04 sits inside that range. The ruling is therefore a FULL_REFUND of the whole contested SGD 4.50 to the filing party - the rider, who filed this dispute - and driver_compensation_sgd is null on this clause.

The rider's case does not depend on, and does not dispute, the drive clock. The trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 400 seconds from 13:17:57 to 13:24:37, 41 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, and the 'arrived' marker at 13:17:57 coincides with the first in-geofence fix, so the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 and the dwell exceeds the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force on this record. On those numbers POL-NS-06 discloses no shortfall (measured shortfall -220 seconds) and POL-NS-01's conditions are not what this case turns on. The case turns on POL-NS-04: a driver who waited out his clock but left three unanswered locating messages from a rider standing inside the arrival radius did not complete the pickup, and that clause refunds the fee in full whether or not the waiting period was served.

The sum to be returned is the whole SGD 4.50, not a part of it. The fare breakdown carries a cancellation_fee line of 4.50, a total_charged of 4.50, an empty waiting-time line and no distance or time fare, and 4.50 is exactly platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this trip, so the line reconciles with the fee schedule and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so nothing has yet been returned to the rider and the full refund is still outstanding.

Nothing on this record impairs the artifacts the rider's case rests on, so the fee can be decided on the money rather than held. The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100.0% coverage, a 10 second cadence, zero gaps and both tracks present; the chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with its message sequence intact and its read receipts recorded; the trip record and the fare breakdown are COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and reconcile to each other. POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) are therefore not engaged - no clock skew, no trace gap over 120 seconds, no chat defect, no fare defect - and the POL-NS-09 confidence-floor and sole-impaired-evidence triggers do not fire, so this dispute is decidable by a monetary ruling.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window, and I disclose that EV-ADVIS-03204-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Limb (i) of POL-NS-06 therefore cannot be run by anyone: it requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and its purpose - summing separate in-geofence intervals - is in any event moot here, because the trace shows run_count 1, a single unbroken 400 second run, with no second interval to add to the first. No party can build a dwell exemption on an advisory that does not exist.

EV-TRIP-03204 carries a driver_arrived event at 2026-08-22T13:17:57+08:00, sourced from PLATFORM_TELEMETRY, and a wait_timer_started event two seconds later; that is limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show, and it is on the record rather than asserted by the driver.

Arrival is independently established by the trace and not merely by the button: EV-GPS-03204 shows 41 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes, the first at 13:17:57, the same second as the arrival event, inside the 50 m radius that applies to this trip's STANDARD zone class (trip_record.pickup_zone_class, not assumed). That satisfies POL-NS-01(b) and POL-NS-02 even on the tightest radius in the fee schedule. The artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100.0% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0 and both tracks present, so the POL-NS-08(b) trace-defect branch is not engaged.

POL-NS-01(c) is satisfied with room to spare: the driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous 400 seconds, from 13:17:57 to 13:24:37, measured as the clause directs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the button tap. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec under the fee schedule's resolution_rule, so the dwell is more than double the minimum in force; it also clears the 300-second STANDARD figure the fee schedule retains for older records.

POL-NS-06, the rider's cleanest arithmetic route, returns nothing on this record: the measured shortfall is -220 seconds, a 220-second surplus over the minimum, and run_count is 1, so there is no second in-geofence interval whose summation could even be in question. There is no waiting-period shortfall to refund.

There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0, so the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at the arrived timestamp itself and the recomputed waiting clock runs from exactly the same moment, producing the same 400-second dwell. Limb (iii) therefore governs, and the marker does not by itself defeat the fee.

POL-NS-01(d) is made out: EV-TRIP-03204 records no boarding event and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 13:24:38 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes the limb recognises, which is 221 seconds after the required 180-second dwell elapsed at 13:20:57. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold governs the cancellation.

The amount the rider contests is the net chargeable figure and it reconciles: EV-FARE-03204 charges a cancellation_fee of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50 and no other fare line, exactly platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd as read from EV-TRIP-03204, so no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) arises and the disputed sum is the net fee.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied and POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 not displacing it on this record, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the 4.50 fee - 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-03204 itself derives. The anti-farming check does not trip: it reads only driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (0, below the four required) and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (118, the quotient 0.00 not above 0.08), and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags, a lifetime counter, for either of them.

ledger.claim: On the rider's exoneration route the driver states the record candidly: EV-CHAT-03204 holds three rider messages (13:18:27, 13:19:47, 13:20:27), of which only MSG-03204-003 was opened by the driver (read 13:20:07), no driver reply appears, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - so limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are engaged on the records as they stand, and the driver does not pretend otherwise. The driver's narrower submission is that the rider's own locating message names a sub-location, 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side', which appears nowhere in the trip record's pickup data (label 'Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6, Pasir Ris', venue VEN-PASIR-RIS-DR6), and that EV-CHAT-03204's header does not reconcile with its own body (last_message_at 13:19:47 against MSG-03204-002 sent 13:20:27). The judge should weigh those points before treating a 400-second verified in-geofence arrival as displaced; if POL-NS-04 is not applied, the fee stands under POL-NS-01 and the payout is fixed by POL-NS-07.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your dispute is upheld. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-03204 is refunded to you in full.

The fee falls because POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered by driver) applies. All three of its limbs hold. (a) EV-CHAT-03204 shows you sent MSG-03204-001 at 13:18:27, inside the waiting window that ran from the driver's arrival at 13:17:57 to his cancellation at 13:24:38: 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you'. That message both asks for the driver's position and states you cannot see the vehicle, so limb (a) is met on it alone; MSG-03204-003 (13:19:47) and MSG-03204-002 (13:20:27) add nothing that is needed. (b) The chat log contains no driver message at all and EV-TRIP-03204.in_app_calls is an empty array, so the driver placed no reply within 120 seconds of any of the three messages and no in-app call at any point before cancelling. A read receipt is not a reply: MSG-03204-003 was read at 13:20:07 and the driver still wrote nothing and called no one for the following four and a half minutes. (c) EV-GPS-03204's rider track holds 68 fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00, every one of them between 15.07 m and 22.11 m from the pickup pin, so all (and therefore the majority) of the qualifying fixes across the waiting window sit inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. Because POL-NS-04 sits between POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06, it also displaces POL-NS-07, so no driver compensation is payable.

To the driver: the no-show conditions themselves were made out and I accept that. EV-TRIP-03204 records your arrived event at 13:17:57 and a termination by you at 13:24:38 under RIDER_NO_SHOW; EV-GPS-03204 independently places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for 41 consecutive qualifying fixes beginning at 13:17:57 and holds you there for a continuous 400 seconds, well over the 180 second free waiting period in force (the record's platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). There is no waiting-period shortfall (measured shortfall -220 seconds), no false arrival marker (the first in-geofence fix coincides with your tap, offset 0.0 s, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged) and no fare-integrity defect (the 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd and total_charged). On those facts alone POL-NS-01 would stand and POL-NS-07 would pay you SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of SGD 4.50 as EV-FARE-03204 itself derives, the anti-farming check not tripping (no_show_terminations_30d 0, completed_trips_30d 118). I do not reach that outcome because POL-NS-04 displaces it, which is its stated effect; nothing about your driving or waiting is criticised here.

I reject the two specific points your advocate raised. First, MSG-03204-003's reference to 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side' cannot defeat limb (a): that limb turns on the type of content a message carries, and POL-NS-03 confines any assertion that a named place is or is not this pickup to a venue_id or a party statement in the chat log, neither of which places the rider anywhere but the pin her own device recorded. Second, the chat header does not reconcile with its body (last_message_at 13:19:47 against MSG-03204-002 sent 13:20:27), but that is not a POL-NS-08(c) chat defect: the msg_id sequence 001 to 003 is intact, the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and it contains no gap over 5 minutes. The log therefore remains COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and is usable.

On the amount and the record: EV-FARE-03204 charges a cancellation_fee of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole 4.50 is still outstanding and is what is returned. Every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-TRIP-03204, EV-GPS-03204, EV-CHAT-03204, EV-FARE-03204) is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on a fact carried by two independent artifacts is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 escalation floor. EV-ADVIS-03204-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0: its absence carries no fact, it makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable to either side, and it is not relied on here - no traffic advisory could matter in any event, because the trace shows a single unbroken in-geofence run of 400 seconds. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was true, and the driver-education referral in POL-NS-01 attaches only where a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE code has been mis-selected, which is not this case. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may lodge one appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
